title: Leaving Rene for Celestin's Tuxedo band
summary: An insurance collector urged him to join the society bands, so he left Rene for the Tuxedo band to make more money.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: That was Celestad. Celestad and Pierron and they were big society bands, you see. And they'd make more money. So I joined Celestad's band, Tuxedo band. They'd heard Rene very much because he liked it so much. He hated it. But there was nothing you could do but I was making more money and everything else. So I worked with the Tuxedo band. And the Tuxedo band, that's what, that's called an original Tuxedo band. And that was long before my time, payback time, and Johnny Sincere, Kirok, we went out with nothing but a baby. The Tuxedo band was formed. So when I got in the band, around the last part of the Tuxedo band, and they came up with a little confusion between Ridgely, the manager of the band, and Papa Celestad. So Papa Celestad quit the band.
